name: pics

source.content:
Rules:

1.. Please mark original photos with [OC] in the title if you're the photographer

2..Pictures containing a politician from any country or planet are prohibited, this is a [community voted on rule.](https://lemmy2.local/post/3881121) 

3.. Image must be a photograph, no AI or digital art.

4.. No NSFW/Cosplay/Spam/Trolling images.

5.. Be civil. No racism or bigotry.


Photo of the Week Rule(s):

1.. On Fridays, the most upvoted original, marked [OC], photo posted between Friday and Thursday will be the next week's banner and featured photo. 

2.. The weekly photos will be saved for an end of the year run off.

[Weeks 2023](https://lemmy2.local/post/3436049)

Instance-wide rules always apply. https://author3.local/about
